occurrenceChecks.text: They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名を明記。

occurrenceChecks.text: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave no portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 「子ら」はヨセフ本人ではなく子孫・部族集団を指すため個人プロフィールへのリンクは除外。

occurrenceChecks.text: The lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, even the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 「子ら」はヨセフ本人ではなく子孫・領地集団を指すため除外。

occurrenceChecks.text: The children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 「子ら」はヨセフ本人ではなく子孫の二部族を指すため除外。

occurrenceChecks.text: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: ヨセフ本人への直接言及ではなく、マナセ族の系譜上の父としての間接関係。個人の出現としては採らない。

occurrenceChecks.text: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 「マナセの子ヨセフ」という系譜上の参照。人物そのものの出来事でないためrelationshipを人物プロフィールに付さない。

occurrenceChecks.text: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance, since we are a numerous people, because the LORD has blessed us so far?”
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 「ヨセフの子ら」は子孫集団でありヨセフ本人ではない。

occurrenceChecks.text: The children of Joseph said, “The hill country is not enough for us. All the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are in Beth Shean and its towns, and those who are in the valley of Jezreel.”
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 「ヨセフの子ら」は子孫集団でありヨセフ本人ではない。

occurrenceChecks.text: Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, that is, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, “You are a numerous people, and have great power. You shall not have one lot only;
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 「ヨセフの家」はエフライムとマナセの子孫集団の呼称。本人ではない。

occurrenceChecks.text: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall live in his borders on the south, and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 「ヨセフの家」は子孫集団の領域を示す。個人本人の出現でない。

occurrenceChecks.text: The lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families. The border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 「ヨセフの子ら」は子孫集団とその領域の呼称。個人本人の出現でない。
